presets.summary: The Worlds card.

presets.summary: Pick which stat a Pokemon's nature raises and lowers.

presets.label: Ability capsule
presets.summary: Switches a Pokemon to its other ability.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Poke Ball changer
presets.summary: Moves a Pokemon into the ball you choose.

presets.label: Gender change
presets.summary: Switches a Pokemon between male and female.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Nickname change
presets.summary: A new nickname, or the species name back.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: IV and EV judge
presets.summary: Shows a Pokemon's nature, six IVs and EVs on screen.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Hidden Power and max IVs
presets.summary: Shows its Hidden Power, then can set every IV to 31.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Hidden Power type
presets.summary: Gives Hidden Power the type you pick.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: EV training
presets.summary: Resets EVs or maxes the stats you pick, no battles.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Friendship checker
presets.summary: Shows friendship and can max it.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: PP Max
presets.summary: Every move in the party gets its most PP.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Max conditions
presets.summary: Contest stats to the max; Feebas then evolves.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Pokerus
presets.summary: The party catches Pokerus, which doubles EVs earned.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Unown letter
presets.summary: Gives an Unown any letter.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Trade evolution
presets.summary: Evolves a trade-evolution Pokemon, no trade.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Espeon or Umbreon
presets.summary: A friendly Eevee evolves into the one you pick.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Move relearner and deleter
presets.summary: Relearn or forget a move; the move tutors teach again.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Double speed
presets.summary: R turns double speed on and off. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Triple speed
presets.summary: R turns triple speed on and off. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Quadruple speed
presets.summary: R turns x4 speed on and off. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Slower game
presets.summary: R plays a little slower. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Half speed
presets.summary: R plays at half speed. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Fast text
presets.summary: All text prints at once until the game is reset. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Fly with R
presets.summary: R flies from outdoors, no HM; run and bike anywhere. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: PC anywhere
presets.summary: R opens the Pokemon boxes from anywhere. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: HM moves without HMs
presets.summary: Cut, Surf, Strength and more with only the badge. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Reusable TMs
presets.summary: Teaching a TM no longer uses it up. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Physical/special split
presets.summary: Each move is physical or special as in later games. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Exp. Share for all
presets.summary: The whole party gets Exp. from every battle. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Shiny chain
presets.summary: Meeting one species again and again makes it shiny more often; R shows the chain. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Roaming Pokemon finder
presets.summary: Says where the roaming Pokemon is and can lure it. Turns off any game boost that is on.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: No encounters or repel
presets.summary: No wild Pokemon, or only stronger ones, until the game is reset.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Legendary respawn
presets.summary: Legendaries you beat without catching come back.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Instant eggs
presets.summary: Hatches the eggs you carry, or readies the Day Care egg.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Gift box
presets.summary: 100,000 money, 99 Rare Candies and 1,000 coins.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Pocket casino

presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Gift ribbons

presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Trainer ID and Secret ID on screen

presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: New trainer name or look
presets.summary: Rename yourself, or switch between boy and girl.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.

presets.label: Rename your rival
presets.summary: Gives your rival a new name.
presets.when: After the card is saved, talk to the delivery man on 2F of any Pokemon Center.
